name: Personal Config & Dotfiles
description: Clones personal config repo, sets up dotfiles symlinks, configures shell and syncs Neovim plugins at build time.

repo.description: Git repository URL of your personal config (e.g. https://github.com/bbchk/personal_config.git)

target_path.description: Absolute path where the repo will be cloned inside the container

dotfiles_dir.description: Relative path inside the repo where dotfiles to symlink live
